parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how SSRIs treat obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Lehmkuhl et al. (2008) treated a boy called Jason who had OCD.
Describe how exposure and response prevention treatment was used to reduce Jason’s
symptoms.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Discuss the validity of the study by Lehmkuhl et al.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe explanations of depression.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate explanations of depression, including a discussion of practical applications. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the purpose of background music played in consumer environments.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the study by North et al. (2003) on music in restaurants.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by North et al.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have learned about consumer decision-making (models,
strategies, marketing theories).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have learned about consumer decision-making (models,
strategies, marketing theories), including a discussion about reductionism. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a ‘psychological measure’ of stress.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe one physiological measure of stress.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the physiological measure described in (b).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about improving adherence to medical advice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about improving adherence to medical advice,
including a discussion about ethics. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘extrinsic motivation’ in relation to work.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe how employees can be motivated by two monetary reward systems.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
For one of the monetary reward systems you referred to in (b):
Explain one strength and one weakness of this reward system for an organisation.

parts.text: Describe theories of job satisfaction.

Evaluate theories of job satisfaction, including a discussion about determinism.
